title: Prove a sharp 104-coordinate owner-local centre repair floor
head: 4c674beb8c752c4c2352e4591638807d23215c49
body:
PR2391 leaves additional old-chart observations as a possible repair for selected centre reuse. This contribution proves a sharp lower bound for one explicit repair contract: recovering the entire later query field requires 104 additional scalar coordinates at each old cover owner when each new observation depends only on that owner's initial 112 source values. The decoder may subsequently mix all observations across owners. This is an information bound, not 104 recursive children or rank-mass units.

The new source-bound step is that all 112 selected stage-1 routes are distinct and every later coefficient column is nonzero. An input supported at one old owner therefore has a rank-112 later-field image, against rank eight in the saved first transcript. An explicit 104-coordinate extension attains the information bound. For one output owner, the distinct subsidiary minima are 112 owner-local evaluations versus eight arbitrary aggregate scalars; the README separates these contracts.

Adds only `research/centre-owner-observation-floor/`. Main: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Selected record and frozen sources are unchanged. Exact Git/SHA-256 source pins and four full-path archive-member pins precede decoding. The receipt contains 112 exact kernel witnesses, all route digests, the two coefficient matrices, and the sharp extension.

Validation (Windows, CPython 3.12.14):

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-owner-observation-floor
```

The registered replay passes the exact emitted-program checker, an independent canonical-word reconstruction with rational kernel checks and modular nonzero minors, and four semantic corruption tests. `git diff --check` also passes. The prescribed first ceiling and lever screen were run; no changed centre profile is claimed.

Native interpretation remains conditional on the inherited common-frame/source-adapter, constant endpoint, and local-view identities in PR2048/PR2391. This package does not run a native evaluator, global compiler, complete cold replay or Lean. No physical access, hosting, restoration, storage, precision or recursive cost saving is supplied, and no supplier/kappa change is claimed. Mixed-owner acquisition, nonlinear encodings and final-output-only contracts remain outside scope. The next question specifies an explicitly priced mixed-owner observation and tests all retained kernel witnesses.

Credit Aaron Wang/navinor (PR2391 `5efcbb6058d27aa8b988db8f18c7b678166b2783`), commdata2338 (PR2048 `a0e55f357344f1742f72942f94ae2a6f13ff7065`), Sagar Thakrar (PR2199 `30ec048eedcaca970f94bbec0fdd3c52eacf9fdc` and Clifford conventions), Adam Gall (PR1918), DreamingOfClouds, and the selected lineage of Rohan Arun/Jeremy Kothe/Hao Yan/icekylinx. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation, writing and separate AI review. Apache-2.0; no independent human or formal review claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
